summary: Docker spawn without env_file is asserted to carry no --env-file, no raw token in argv, and a /run/secrets mount whose source is not the host credential path and whose content is the task capability; shell spawn's exported auth file is asserted distinct from the host file; shared client (_default_client/_make_client), live (client.live + shell /tasks/t2/live curl stdin), and _TASK_LIB panopticon_advance are each asserted to send the bearer from that file, so mounting the host file directly, passing the token by env, or an unauthenticated lib call is rejected.
